result:
The proposed answer of 12 matches what I recall of the published result on rational preperiodic points of quadratic rational maps over Q with nonabelian automorphism group. I could not derive the bound independently, so this is a recollection plus a plausibility check, not a full verification.

- **Setup:** A quadratic rational map has automorphism group trivial, C₂, or S₃, so nonabelian means S₃. The S₃ can be placed in PGL₂(Q) as the anharmonic group.
- **Orbit structure:** The set of rational preperiodic points is S₃-invariant, so it splits into S₃-orbits on P¹(Q). The rational orbits have size 3 or 6. The size-3 orbits are {0, 1, ∞} and {−1, 2, 1/2}, and every other rational orbit has size 6.
- **Consistency of 12:** A total of 3 + 3 + 6 = 12 is a union of such orbits, so it is structurally plausible.

I did not check the proposed solution's claims about which dynamical types (fixed, period-2, period-3) occupy which orbits, and I did not construct an explicit map attaining 12.

VERDICT: ACCEPT
